message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, filed November 1, 2024) and confirmed the company earned **operating income of $123,216 million** on **net sales of $391,035 million** — roughly a 31.5% operating margin, with gross margin of $180,683 million against total operating expenses of $57,467 million. That combination of scale and margin durability justified a purchase under my standing mandate. I checked the live quote ($222.70 last, $222.72 ask as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC) and placed a single buy limit order for **44 shares of AAPL at $222.75**, which filled at $222.75 for about **$9,801** — within the $10,000 per-order limit, within the $20,000 daily total, and well covered by the $50,000 cash balance. No funds were moved out of the account, and no MSFT position was touched.
